Friends
923 - 924 - The one in Barbados

Part 1 written by: Shana Goldberg-Meehan & Scott Silveri
莎娜·戈德堡-米汉和斯科特·西尔维里
Part 2 written by: Marta Kauffman & David Crane
第 2 部分 作者：Marta Kauffman 和 David Crane
Directed by: Kevin S.
导演：凯文·S. Bright
明亮的
Transcribed by: Andreina, Eleonora, Pheeboh, Sebastiano & Vanessa
转录：Andreina、Eleonora、Pheeboh、Sebastiano 和 Vanessa

[Scene: Central Perk]

Joey: (entering) Hey!
（进来）嘿！ I'm all packed and ready to go!
我已经收拾好一切准备出发了！

Ross: Oh, that's right!
哦，原来如此！ (to Emma) Daddy and uncle Joey are going on a trip today.
（对艾玛）爸爸和乔伊叔叔今天要去旅行。 We're going to a conference in Barbados, right?
我们要去巴巴多斯参加一个会议，对吧？

Joey: Mmh-mmh.
嗯嗯。

Ross: (to Emma) Can you say Barbados?
（对艾玛）你能说巴巴多斯吗？

Joey: Barbados!
巴巴多斯！

Ross: Ok, I gotta say.
好吧，我得说。 I mean, it means so much to me that you guys are coming all the way over there to hear me do my speech!
我的意思是，你们大老远跑到那里来听我演讲对我来说意义重大！ UH!
呃！ And I've a surprise, uh...
我有一个惊喜，呃... I had to pull some strings but I was able to get everyone passes to the entire conference!
我托了点关系，给你们每人都弄到了全程会议通行证！ That's right!
这是正确的！ (he gives them their passes) This babies will get you into all the paleontology lectures and seminars.
（递出通行证）有了这些宝贝，所有古生物学讲座和研讨会你们都能进。

Rachel: Do you have anything that would...
你有什么东西可以... get us out of them?
让我们摆脱他们？

Chandler: Yeah Ross, I mean...
是的，罗斯，我的意思是... we're excited to hear the speech but the rest of the time we're gonna wanna do, you know, "island's stuff".
我们很高兴听到这次演讲，但剩下的时间我们想做，你知道的，“岛上的事情”。

Phoebe: I think David would probably wanna hear a few lectures.
我想大卫可能想听一些讲座。

Ross: Oh, right, because he's a scientist!
哦，对了，因为他是科学家！

Phoebe: No, no, because, you know, he's been in Minsk for 8 years and if he gets too much direct sunlight, he'll die.
不，不，因为，你知道，他已经在明斯克呆了八年了，如果阳光直射太多，他就会死。

Ross: Ok, we gotta go, yeah?
好吧，我们该走了，是吗？ So, we'll see you guys tomorrow.
那么，我们明天见。

Joey: All right, let's do it!
好吧，我们开始吧！ 5 hour flight with Charlie, have a couple of drinks, get under that blanket and do what comes naturally.
与查理一起飞行 5 小时，喝几杯饮料，盖上毯子，做自然而然的事情。

Ross: It's a blanket Joe, not a cloak of invisibility!
这是乔毯子，不是隐形斗篷！

Opening credits

[Scene: Paradise Hotel lounge in Barbados]

Charlie: Wow!
哇！ This place is beautiful!
这个地方很漂亮！

Ross: (very excited) Look at all these paleontologists!!
（非常兴奋）看看这些古生物学家！！

Joey: I know, there are gonna be some pasty folks by the pool tomorrow!
明天泳池边准有一堆皮肤惨白的家伙。 (A woman goes towards them)

Woman: Oh my God, I can't believe you're here!
天哪，我不敢相信你在这里！

Joey: (to Charlie) I think I've been recognized, this happens all the time!
（对查理）我想我已经被认出来了，这种事经常发生！

Woman: Doctor Geller, I'm such a huge fan!
盖勒博士，我真是个超级粉丝！

Joey: That...
那... never happens...
永远不会发生...

Woman: I've been following your career for years, I-I can't wait for your keynote speech.
我多年来一直关注你的职业生涯，我-我等不及你的主题演讲了。

Ross: Wow!
哇！ This is very flattering, uh...
这真是太让人赏心悦目了，呃……

Woman: I would love your autograph.
我很喜欢你的签名。 (hands him a notepad)

Ross: Uh, uh...
呃，呃…… Sure!
当然！ Uhm...
嗯…… "Dear..."
“亲爱的...” (he takes the notepad)

Woman: Sarah.
莎拉.

Ross: "... Sarah.
莎拉. I dig you", Uh?
我喜欢你”，呃？ "Doctor Ross Geller".
“罗斯·盖勒博士”。

Sarah: Thank you so much!
太感谢了！

Ross: Yeah, oh and Sarah...
是的，哦，还有莎拉…… I'd like to introduce you to my colleague, uh, Professor Wheeler, a-and this is Joey Tribbiani.
我想向您介绍我的同事，呃，惠勒教授，这是乔伊·崔比安尼。

Sarah: (to Joey) Are you a paleontologist?
（对乔伊）你是古生物学家吗？

Joey: No, God, no!
不，上帝，不！ No!
不！ No no, I'm an actor.
不不，我是演员。 You'd probably recognize me from a little show called "The Days of Our Lives".
你可能会在一个名为“我们的日子”的小节目中认出我。

Ross: Dude, it's just "Days of Our Lives"...
乔伊，剧名就是《我们的日子》…… there's no the.
前面没有“the”。

Joey: (thinking he's kidding) Ok, Ross!
（以为他在开玩笑）好吧，罗斯！ It's...
它是... It's fun, yeah!
很有趣，是啊！ No, I-I play Doctor Drake Ramoray.
不，我-我扮演德雷克·拉莫雷医生。

Sarah: I'm sorry, I don't own a TV.
抱歉，我没有电视。

Joey: You don't own a TV?
你没有电视吗？ What's all your furniture pointed at??
你所有的家具都指向什么？

[Scene: Central Perk]

Monica: David, can you help me?!
大卫，你能帮我吗？ I'm trying to explain to Chandler how a plane stays in the air.
我正试图向钱德勒解释飞机是如何在空中停留的。

David: Oh, certainly.
哦，当然。 That's a combination of Bernoulli's principle and Newton's third law of motion.
这是伯努利原理和牛顿第三运动定律的结合。

Monica: (to Chandler) See?
（对钱德勒）看到了吗？

Chandler: Yeah, that's the same as "it has something to do with wind".
是的，这和“与风有关”是一样的。

Monica: Alright, I'm gonna go pick up a few things for the trip.
好吧，我去买一些旅行用的东西。

Phoebe: Oh, I should go, too.
哦，我也该走了。 Oh, now...
哦，现在... tomorrow do you guys wanna share a cab to the airport or should Mike and I just meet you there.
明天你们想一起搭出租车去机场吗？还是迈克和我直接去机场接你们。

(Everyone looks at her)

Phoebe: Mike??
迈克？？ Who's Mike?
迈克是谁？

David: Mike is your ex...
迈克是你的前任... uh...
呃... boyfriend!
男朋友！

Phoebe: That's right!
这是正确的！ Oh, yeah...
哦，是的... Well, I've totally forgotten about im!
我都把他忘得一干二净了！ AH!
啊！ That's-That's...
那是——那是…… a blast from the past!
真是往事重现啊！

David: It's ok.
没关系。 Ho-honest mistake.
何诚实的错误。

Phoebe: Really, it doesn't mean anything.
真的，这没有任何意义。 I mean, you know, Monica refers to Chandler as Richard all the time!
我的意思是，你知道，莫妮卡一直把钱德勒称为理查德！

Chandler: (upset) She does?
（不安）她有吗？

Monica: (pinching her) Let's get you out of here!!
（掐她）让我们带你离开这里！ (they go outside)

(Outside the Central Perk)

Monica: At least you took me down with you!
至少你还把我一起拉下水了！

Phoebe: I'm sooo sorry!!
我真的很抱歉！！ I just...
我只是... I keep thinking about Mike!
我一直在想迈克！ I'm crazy about David, and we're having so much fun together.
我为大卫着迷，我们在一起玩得很开心。 Why-Why do I miss Mike?
为什么——为什么我想念迈克？ That's-that's gonna go away, right?
那——那会消失的，对吧？

Monica: I guess, in time.
过些时间，大概会吧。

Phoebe: Yeah.
是的。

Monica: I mean, my feelings for Richard are certainly gone.
我的意思是，我对理查德的感情肯定已经消失了。

Phoebe: You just did it again.
你刚刚又做了一次。 Chandler, your feelings for Chandler are certainly gone!
钱德，你对钱德的感情肯定消失了！

[Scene: Inside Central Perk]

David: (to Chandler) Well, Phoebe's still pretty hung up on that Mike, uh?
（对钱德勒）嗯，菲比还是很迷恋那个迈克，呃？

Chandler: I wouldn't read too much into it.
我不会对此进行太多解读。

David: Still you know, a girl calls you by your ex-boyfriend's name, that-that's not a good thing, right?
不过你知道吗，一个女孩叫你前男友的名字，那不是一件好事，对吧？

Chandler: David, let me stop you there 'cause I think I see where this is going.
大卫，让我阻止你，因为我想我明白事情的发展方向。 I'm not very good at giving advice.
我不太擅长提供建议。 So if you want advice, go to Ross, Monica, or...
所以如果你需要建议，请去找罗斯、莫妮卡，或者…… Joey, if the thing you wanna advice about is pizza toppings or burning sensation when you pee.
乔伊，如果你想建议的是披萨配料或小便时的烧灼感。

David: Sorry, I just...
抱歉，我只是... I wish there was something I could do, you know?
我希望我能做点什么，你知道吗？ Well, you know Phoebe...
嗯，你知道菲比...

Chandler: Seriously, we're gonna do this?
说真的，我们要这么做吗？

David: I'm sorry, uh...
对不起，呃... I just wish I could make her forget about Mike already, you know...
我只是希望我能让她忘记迈克，你知道...... Why did Phoebe and Mike break up?
菲比和迈克为什么分手？

Chandler: Oh, because his penis was too big.
哦，因为他的阴茎太大了。 (he notices that David is not amused) Oh, I'm sorry, that's the kind of thing I do.
（他注意到大卫并没有被逗乐）哦，对不起，我就是这么做的。 (pause) They broke up because Mike didn't want to get married.
（停顿）他们分手是因为迈克不想结婚。 Hey, what if you just let Phoebe know you'd be open to marriage?
嘿，如果你让菲比知道你愿意结婚呢？

David: That's great!
那太棒了！ That's great!
那太棒了！ I-I'll propose to her!
我、我要向她求婚！

Chandler: What?
什么？

David: Well, I was probably going to do it at some point.
嗯，我可能会在某个时候这么做。

Chandler: I didn't mean now...
我不是说现在...

David: Why not?
为什么不呢？ It's brilliant!
太棒了！ (talking to an imaginary Mike) Goodbye Mike, we'll see you at the wedding, fella!
（与想象中的迈克交谈）再见迈克，我们婚礼上见，伙计！ (pause) well, we probably won't invite you to the wedding...
（停顿）好吧，我们可能不会邀请你参加婚礼…… (to Chandler) Thank you, Chandler.
（对钱德勒）谢谢你，钱德勒。 Sincerely.
真挚地。

Chandler: Well, you're welcome!
好吧，不客气！ Glad I could help.
很高兴我能帮忙。

David: (after a while) How do you think I should propose?
（过了一会儿）你觉得我应该怎样求婚呢？

Chandler: David, I'm pretending to read here!!
大卫，我假装在这里读书！！

[Scene: Joey in his hotel in room in Barbados]

(Trying on a hat and talking to his own reflection in the mirror)

Joey: Yeah!
是的！ How you doin'?
你好吗'？ Yeah alright!
是啊，好吧！

(Charlie comes out the bathroom)

Joey: Hey, hey!
嘿嘿！ You said you're gonna wear a thong, where's the thong?
你说你要穿丁字裤，丁字裤在哪里？

Charlie: (laughing) I didn't mean a thong...
（笑）我不是说丁字裤…… I meant thongs...
我是说夹脚拖鞋，thongs……

Joey: You really should have been more clear about that!
你真的应该更清楚这一点！

(Someone knocks the door, Joey goes to open it and Ross is on the other side)

Ross: Hey!
嘿！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

Ross: (Excited) You're never going to guess who I just saw downstairs!
（兴奋）你永远猜不到我刚刚在楼下看到了谁！

Joey: Oh!
哦！ ah!
啊！ eh...
呃…… Britney Spears!?
布兰妮·斯皮尔斯！？

Ross: Yeah, she never misses these conferences!
是的，她从来不会错过这些会议！ (then to Charlie) No, I just saw Dr. Kenneth Schwartz!
（然后对查理）不，我刚刚看到肯尼思·施瓦茨博士！

Charlie: Oh my God!
我的天啊！ Did you talk to him?
你跟他说话了吗？

Ross: Yeah...
是的... what am I going to say to Kenneth Schwartz?
我要对肯尼思·施瓦茨说什么？

Joey: You could say: "Hey Kenny, how come you're not Britney Spears?"
你可以说：“嘿肯尼，你怎么不是布兰妮·斯皮尔斯？” (looks at Ross matter-of-factly)

Ross: (to Charlie) Ready to go?
（对查理）准备好了吗？

Charlie: Yeah!
是的！

Joey: Wha...?
什……？ You're gonna go now?
你现在要走吗？ I thought we could hang out?
我以为我们可以出去玩？

Charlie: Oh I can't...
哦，我不能... I have seminars all day and I promised Ross I would look at his speech.
我整天都有研讨会，我答应罗斯我会看他的演讲。

Ross: Yeah.
是的。

Charlie: But maybe we can have dinner later?
但也许我们可以晚点吃晚饭？ On the balcony?
在阳台上？ Will be romantic.
会很浪漫。

Joey: (smiling) Will you wear a thong?
（微笑）你会穿丁字裤吗？

Charlie: I will if you will.
如果你愿意的话我会的。

Joey: Oh...
哦... you got yourself a very weird deal!
你给自己做了一笔非常奇怪的交易！

Ross: (a little embarassed by their conversation) I'm good, I have dinner plans (moves away from them).
（对他们的谈话有点尴尬）我很好，我有晚餐计划（远离他们）。

Charlie: So you'll be ok?
那你会没事吧？

Joey: Yeah, yeah.
是啊是啊。 I've got tons of stuff I could do.
我有很多事情可以做。 I'm gonna hit the beach, go swimming...
我要去海滩，去游泳……

Ross: Uh, Joe, have you looked outside?
呃，乔，你看过外面吗？

Joey: No, why?
不，为什么？

(Ross goes to the window and opens the curtains revealing that it's raining outside)

Joey: Oh man!
天啊！

Charlie: There's an indoor pool, you can swim there!
有室内泳池，可以去游泳！ (Ross agrees)

Joey: I wasn't gonna swim, I was gonna dig a hole!
我不是要游泳，我是要挖洞！ (removes a small plastic spade used by children to play on the beach from his backpack)

[Scene: Back in New York, Monica and Chandler in Central Perk on the couch]

Monica: Wow!
哇！ That Mike thing was interesting!
迈克的事很有趣！ I don't know what's gonna happen with Phoebe and David.
我不知道菲比和大卫会发生什么。

Chandler: (smiling cheekily) I do!
（厚颜无耻地微笑）我愿意！ Want a hint?
想要提示吗？ huh?
嗯？ "I do" (Monica looks confused, so Chandler repeats) "I do".
“我愿意”（莫妮卡看起来很困惑，钱德勒重复道）“我愿意”。

Monica: Ok, I'm sensing that this is some kind of word play, because you are pink with barely controlled glee.
好吧，我感觉这是某种文字游戏，因为你是粉红色的，几乎无法控制喜悦。

Chandler: David is going to propose to Phoebe.
大卫要向菲比求婚。

Monica: What?
什么？ (looks very shocked) Why?
（看起来很震惊）为什么？

Chandler: Be-cause, we were talking about ways that he could beat Mike and I told him that Phoebe wanted to get married.
因为，我们正在讨论他可以击败迈克的方法，我告诉他菲比想结婚。

Monica: Chandler, we have talked about this.
钱德勒，我们已经讨论过这个了。 You are not supposed to give people advice!
你不应该给别人建议！ Now couldn't you just have made some sort of inappropriate joke?
现在你就不能开个不恰当的玩笑吗？

Chandler: I did!
我做到了！ A penis one!
讲了个阴茎笑话！ Look, just so I know, what was so wrong about what I said?
听着，我知道我说的话有什么问题吗？

Monica: They've only been going out for a few weeks and Phoebe is completely hung up on Mike!
他们才约会几周，菲比就完全迷上了迈克！ She'll say "No", David's heart will be broken, it will be too hard for them to recover from and then Phoebe will end up alone again.
她会说“不”，大卫的心将会破碎，他们将很难从中恢复过来，然后菲比将再次独自一人。

Chandler: Man, that's some bad advice!
伙计，这是个糟糕的建议！

[Scene: Barbados, hotel lounge. David, Phoebe and Rachel have just arrived.]

(Joey spots them and walks towards them)

Joey: Oh!
哦！ Hey!
嘿！ Thank God you guys are here!
感谢上帝，你们都在这里！

Rachel: Hey!
嘿！ Hey what's going on?
嘿，发生什么事了？

Joey: Everything is upside down here!
这里一切都颠倒了！ It rains all day long, nobody watches tv and Ross is famous!
一整天都在下雨，没有人看电视，而罗斯却出名了！

(Rachel turns around and sees Chandler and Monica arriving)

Rachel: Alright, I don't wanna alarm anybody, but Monica's hair is twice as big as it was when we landed!
好吧，我不想惊动任何人，但莫妮卡的头发比我们着陆时大了一倍！

(Monica and Chandler reach the group)

Monica: Ok!
好的！ When I go places with high humidity, it gets a little extra body, ok?!
天气潮湿，我头发就会稍微蓬松一点，好吧？！

Chandler: That's why our honeymoon photos look like me and Diana Ross!
这就是为什么我们的蜜月照片看起来像我和戴安娜·罗斯！

Joey: Come on, I'll show you guys where to check in (Joey, Chandler and David leave)
来，我带你们去办入住。（乔伊、钱德勒和大卫离开）

Monica: (to Chandler) Oh, honey, can you make sure we get a King size bed!
（对钱德勒）哦，亲爱的，你能确保我们得到一张特大号床吗？

Phoebe: (shouts after David) Oh!
（在大卫身后大喊）哦！ David, get one for us too!
大卫，也给我们买一份吧！ Oh, oh, and see if they have a heart-shaped one!
哦哦，看看他们有没有心形的！ And with mirrors on the ceiling!
天花板上还有镜子！

Monica: (shouts to Chandler) And make sure our room isn't next to theirs (points to Phoebe).
（对钱德勒大喊）并确保我们的房间不在他们的旁边（指着菲比）。

Rachel: Ooh!
哦！ You guys are so lucky you are here with people, you known it's such a romantic place.
你们很幸运能和人们在一起，你知道这是一个如此浪漫的地方。 That's all, I just wish I could (looks at Joey who is at the check in desk) share that with a guy.
就这样，我只是希望我能（看着在登记处的乔伊）与一个人分享这一点。

Phoebe: Not Joey.
不是乔伊。

Rachel: Not Joey, no, I was just lusting after Chandler.
不是乔伊，不，我只是渴望钱德勒。

Monica: Yeah, right!
是啊，对！

[Cut to the guys]

David: So, ehm...
所以，嗯... I'm proposing to Pheobe tonight.
今晚我要向菲比求婚。 (Removes a ring box from his pocket and opens it to show Chandler the ring)

Chandler: Tonight?!
今晚？！ (looks at the ring) Isn't an engagement ring supposed to have a diamond?
（看着戒指）订婚戒指不是应该有钻石吗？ (squints at the ring to emphasize how tiny the diamond is) Oh, there it is!
（眯着眼睛看着戒指，强调这颗钻石有多小）哦，就在那里！

David: Yeah, well, being a failed scientist doesn't pay quite as well as you might think.
是的，作为一名失败的科学家并没有你想象的那么好。 That's uhm...
那是嗯... one seventieth of a karat.
七十分之一克拉。 And the clarity is uhm...
净度嘛…… is quite poor.
很差。

Chandler: (slaps him on the shoulder) Nice!
（拍拍他的肩膀）太好了！ (goes to Monica)

Chandler: Monica, can I talk to you for a sec?
莫妮卡，我可以和你聊聊吗？ (Pulls her away from Phoebe and Rachel)

Monica: Ok!
好的！

Chandler: David is going to propose to Phoebe tonight!
今晚大卫要向菲比求婚！

Monica: See what happens when you give people advice?
看看当你给别人建议时会发生什么？ I hope you told him not to?
我希望你告诉他不要这样做？

Chandler: That would be advice!!
这将是建议！

Monica: Ok fine.
好吧，好吧。 I'll handle this.
我会处理这件事。 (goes to Phoebe who's talking to Rachel) Phoebe?
（走向正在和瑞秋说话的菲比）菲比？

Phoebe: Yeah?
是的？

Monica: (looking very serious) I need to talk to you.
（看起来很严肃）我需要和你谈谈。

Phoebe: Are you leaving "The Supremes"?
你要退出至上女声组合了吗？ (Monica and Phoebe go to one side)

MOnica: Ok, my husband just gave your boyfriend some very bad advice.
好吧，我丈夫刚刚给了你男朋友一些非常糟糕的建议。 Look, David is going to propose to you tonight.
听着，大卫今晚要向你求婚了。

Phoebe: Wow?
哇？ Really?
真的吗？ That's fantastic!

[1] Homo ergaster: Some scientists classify some African erectus specimens as belonging to a separate species, Homo ergaster, which differs from the Asian H. erectus fossils in some details of the skull (e.g. the brow ridges differ in shape, and erectus would have a larger brain size).
